expected_level_description: You can: - explain the purchase-to-pay and order-to-cash processes and your part in them - enter invoices, receipts, and payments accurately, following set procedures - check that a transaction has the right approval and supporting documents
You can: - use the finance system for your own tasks, following procedures - run standard reports and export data to a spreadsheet
You can: - follow the organisation's financial procedures and schemes of delegation - recognise signs of possible fraud or error and report them
You can: - explain that the organisation spends public money and must account for it - explain the difference between capital and revenue spending
You can: - listen to the needs of design and business stakeholders and interpret information - take part in discussions within a multidisciplinary team
You can: - follow the organisation's rules for handling personal and health information - recognise and report a data breach or near miss
You can: - describe the main parts of the health and care system and the services the organisation supports - explain why patient safety and confidentiality matter in your work
